label: Applying to a French public university through Parcoursup for autumn 2027

milestones.label: Parcoursup registration and wishes open
milestones.note: In 2026 this was 19 January. The 2027 calendar is usually published in late autumn.

milestones.label: Last day to enter your wishes
Last day to complete your file and confirm your wishes
milestones.note: In 2026 this was 1 April. An unconfirmed wish is lost.

milestones.label: Admission phase: answer each offer within its deadline
milestones.note: In 2026 it ran from 2 June to 11 July. Offers arrive before IB results, on your file and predicted grades.

notes: For EU, EEA and Swiss nationals. Non-EU applicants to a first-year licence use the demande d'admission préalable (DAP), which is not recorded as a route here.
Up to 10 wishes, not ranked. Ranking only applies later, to wishes still on a waiting list.
